summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the upload directory by name. It also changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Arbitrary file read through download name
findings.problem: The download handler joins the name query parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A name with ../ segments or an absolute path such as /etc/passwd escapes the upload directory.
findings.consequence: Any client can read any file the server process can read. That includes secrets, config files and source code.
findings.fix: Use werkzeug safe_join or flask send_from_directory, which reject paths outside the base. Return 404 when the result is None.

findings.title: Debug server exposed on all interfaces
findings.problem: The change turns on debug mode and binds the server to 0.0.0.0 instead of 127.0.0.1. The debug mode enables the interactive Werkzeug debugger.
findings.consequence: Anyone on the network can reach the debugger after an error and may run arbitrary code. The download traversal can leak the files needed to compute the debugger PIN.
findings.fix: Restore host 127.0.0.1 and read the debug flag from an environment variable that defaults to off.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds the download handler with a 404 path and a file-serving path. The repository has no test that exercises either path.
findings.consequence: Regressions in the path check would go unnoticed. That includes the traversal guard this endpoint needs.
findings.fix: Add tests for a valid file, a missing file, and traversal names such as ../etc/passwd and /etc/passwd.
